name: Parrot S.A.
summary: Parrot S.A. engages in the designing, developing, and marketing professional micro-drones and software solutions in France and internationally. It offers ANAFI UKR, a sovereign ISR micro-UAV range for defense, public safety, and government; CHUCK 3.0, a self-contained autopilot module; ANAFI Ai, a 4G robotic UAV; ANAFI USA, a partner ecosystem for drones; and 3D models of Parrot ANAFI drones and controllers.
